description_expanded: Overview🏝 Castaway at Seagrove – Luxury NatureWalk Retreat Backing to State Forest, 6 Bikes QUICK HIGHLIGHTS:✔ Located in NatureWalk at Seagrove – One of 30A’s most sought-after communities✔ Backs to Point Washington State Forest – Peaceful views & unmatched privacy✔ Less Than 1 Mile to the Beach – Access via scenic nature trail or bike ride✔ 6 Bedrooms / 4.5 Bathrooms – Comfortably sleeps up to 14 guests✔ 2 Master Suites – Ideal for multi-family stays✔ Screened Back Porch + Front Porch Swing – Sunrise forest views & sunset pond views✔ Large Open Living Area with Vaulted Ceilings & Fireplace✔ Fully Equipped Gourmet Kitchen – Quartz countertops & premium appliances✔ Large Dining Table (Seats 8) + Counter Seating for 4✔ Game Room with Xbox One, Games & Controllers – Family-friendly fun✔ iMac for Guest Use – Stay connected during your stay✔ Full-Size Washer & Dryer – Convenient for longer vacations✔ Outdoor Shower – Perfect after beach days✔ 6 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A with ease✔ Tesla / EV Charging Outlet in Garage✔ Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support Welcome to Castaway at SeagroveWelcome to Castaway at Seagrove, a stunning 3,325 sq. ft. custom-built luxury home located in the heart of NatureWalk, one of the most desirable communities along Scenic Highway 30A. Designed to deliver a refined yet comfortable vacation experience, this spacious home is surrounded by nature while remaining close to everything that makes 30A special.The home backs directly to Point Washington State Forest, offering serene views, privacy, and peaceful mornings on the screened back porch as the sun rises through the trees. In the evenings, unwind on the front porch swing overlooking Sunset Pond — the perfect setting to relax after a full beach day.Inside, the open-concept living area features hardwood floors, vaulted ceilings, a cozy fireplace, and premium furnishings throughout. Gather for movie nights on the large-screen TV with surround sound or enjoy friendly competition in the game room featuring an Xbox One with games and controllers.The gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream, complete with quartz countertops, a gas cooktop, built-in microwave and oven, dishwasher, and a large stainless refrigerator. With a spacious dining table seating eight and additional counter seating for four, there’s plenty of room for meals and memories together.This home offers two master suites and a well-designed bedroom layout perfect for families or groups. All bedrooms feature wall-mounted flat-screen TVs and premium mattresses for restful nights. A Pack ‘n Play is available in Master Suite II for added convenience.Guests can enjoy access to NatureWalk’s incredible community amenities, including pools, a hot tub, playground, fire pit, grills, pickleball courts, basketball courts, fitness stations, and miles of scenic walking and biking trails. The nearby nature trail provides a peaceful route toward the beach, making the journey part of the experience.🛏 SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 14)Master Suite I – First Floor: King bed, private bath with walk-in shower & soaking tubMaster Suite II – Second Floor: King bed, private bath with walk-in showerGuest Bedroom I – Second Floor: King bed, shared bath with shower/tub comboGuest Bedroom II – Second Floor: Queen bed, shared bath with shower/tub comboGuest Bedroom III – Second Floor: Queen bed, shared bath with shower/tub comboBunk Room – Second Floor: Two twin-over-twin bunks with twin trundles, en suite bath We look forward to welcoming you to Castaway at Seagrove — where luxury living meets the natural beauty of 30A.The SpaceShow less
